key_insight: A planner-executor multimodal AI system can answer patient questions about lung cancer screening CT results while deciding when to defer to a physician.
clinical_relevance: This could improve patient understanding and follow-up in lung cancer screening programs without overstepping into questions that need clinician input.
method: Used 116 lung cancer screening CT reports and images from a tertiary academic hospital
Generated 699 simulated patient questions, split into answerable vs defer-to-doctor categories
Evaluated tool-calling, self-regulation, and physician-rated response quality
evidence_signal: The system achieved 93.1% tool-calling accuracy and 92.6% self-regulation accuracy, with strong physician-rated clinical accuracy and understandability in a 100-response reader study.
watch_item: Results were based on retrospective data and simulated questions, so real-world performance, safety, and patient comprehension still need prospective testing.
paper_title: Planner-Executor Style Multimodal Agentic System to Answer Patient Questions in Lung Cancer Screening CT
